title: Bora Employer Pipeline Job Record
description: Canonical structured record for one discovered job in the Bora Employer Pipeline OS. This schema stores verified source facts and explicit unknown states. It must not infer missing facts.

job_id.description: Permanent unique identifier assigned deterministically by the system.

official_url.description: Employer-owned careers-page URL when verified. Null if unavailable or not yet found. Must be an absolute http or https URL without embedded credentials.

discovery_url.description: URL where the role was originally discovered, if available. Must be an absolute http or https URL without embedded credentials.

location.description: Location exactly as verified from the source. Null if not provided.

board_posted_date.description: Posting date displayed by the discovery source when available.

discovered_date.description: Date the role was discovered by the pipeline. Stored separately from first-seen and board-posted dates.

date_first_seen.description: Date the role was first seen as a live posting. Must not be collapsed into discovered_date.

date_last_verified.description: Most recent date the role's live/source status was verified.

repost_evidence.description: Verified reposting or contradictory-date evidence. Null when no such evidence is available.

role_status.description: Role freshness classification only (Blueprint §20/§21). Independent from source_verification_status. Must not classify a job as stale or fake from one weak signal.

source_verification_status.description: Direct-source verification axis (Blueprint §19), stored separately from role_status. Allowed values are implementation vocabulary, not Blueprint-locked terminology. Do not infer role_status from this field or vice versa.

role_family.description: Functional role family assigned during analysis. Null until classified.

seniority.description: Seniority as supported by the posting. Null if unclear rather than guessed.

jd_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the job description used for analysis.

work_authorization_wording.description: Exact or faithfully captured work-authorization language from the source. This is descriptive evidence, not a legal conclusion.

sponsorship_wording.description: Exact or faithfully captured sponsorship-related language from the source when present.

opt_flag.description: Screening signal only. It must not be treated as a legal determination of OPT eligibility.

initial_opt_relevance.description: Career/degree relevance assessment for initial OPT. Legal certainty is handled separately.

future_stem_quality.description: Strategic quality for a potential future STEM OPT pathway. Must remain separate from initial OPT relevance.

immigration_verification_status.description: Verification state for consequential immigration-related conclusions.

e_verify_result.description: E-Verify result. NOT_FOUND_IN_PUBLIC_SEARCH must never be converted into NOT_ENROLLED.

evidence_matches.description: Identifiers for evidence-match records associated with this job.

major_gaps.description: Material gaps that remain after evidence matching. Must not be hidden or creatively solved.

resume_version.description: Identifier of the derivative resume version associated with the job. Null before generation.

network_action.description: Reference to the approved networking action or recommendation. Null when none exists.
